# E47-D02 accessibility design audit catalogue

<!-- Generated by docs/plan/a11y/_tools/catalogue.py from 47-audit-register.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Auditor agent-run (E47-D02 lane), 2026-10-31, over the E47-T01 register at sha `a6ec967627b7`. A text-first design audit of every id SCR-001 to SCR-159 in `14-screens-catalogue.md`: the T01 observed findings and the merged spec-level a11y design reviews, joined per screen, normalised to four severities and routed to one design owner (E47-D03 to E47-D10) or to engineering-only with a reason. Design reviews are spec-level: cited as findings, never counted as conformance evidence. Partial against #1301: the open items are listed in section 4. Inputs pinned by git blob: `14` at `c3ad20c64a90`, `findings.json` at `55fb95f3a45d`; `--check` regenerates against those blobs, so a later edit to either file is reported as pending drift, folded at the pack's next touch, and never a failure.

## 4. Open items for #1301

- Routed to the coordinator and owner, not done here: Penpot frame annotations, the NVDA live pass and mirror-lag measurement, the 5-screen inter-rater calibration and third-reviewer check, the E47-D01 blocker absorption (D01 is unmerged), the D03 to D10 lead review of the routing, CDO sign-off and the 31-sprint-plan reorder.
- Canvas four-layer verification, and the missing-layer blocker rule, pending a build. Only the screens listed with a canvas check in section 3 carry one, and those come from keyword matches on the 14 A11y line.
- Contrast pairs are cited from the T01 and review tables, not re-measured here.
- The four Blockers (E09-D10 F-1, F-2, F-25, F-26) are carried by #5254 (the fix issue for the E09 Blocking rows) and #193 (the held E09-D10 delta re-review); both are named on each Blocker row in section 3.
- Inter-rater agreement carried from the E47-T01 sweep (`docs/qa/a11y/e47-t01-sweep.md` section 10.1, not recomputed here: this tool reads no rater data): primary Cohen's kappa 0.61 (n = 96, six WCAG 2.2 criteria); secondary kappa 0.28 (n = 880, 55 criteria, fail against not-fail), below the 0.6 target because fails are rare (chance agreement 0.962).
- Correction to that sweep's section 13 row "STEST not in CI": `scripts/tests/test_a11y_finding_schema.py` (STEST) does run in CI, in the `governance` lane, which runs the `scripts/tests` suites on every PR. The row is wrong; the sweep document is owned by its own PR and is not edited here.
